note: CKEditor Media Embed adds CKEditor 5's Media Embed to Drupal. Authors insert a media URL; CKEditor stores an <oembed url> tag; the reversible text filter filter_ckeditor_media_embed ('Convert Oembed tags to media embeds') converts it to embed HTML at render time by resolving each URL through the configurable oEmbed provider (config ckeditor_media_embed.settings -> embed_provider, Iframely by default). The CKEditor plugin JS is NOT bundled and is downloaded with 'drush ckeditor_media_embed:install' / ':update'. Config object is ckeditor_media_embed.settings (embed_provider, ckeditor_version, plugins_version_installed). Settings route ckeditor_media_embed.ckeditor_media_embed_settings_form at /admin/config/media/ckeditor-media-embed/settings (permission administer filters). Also provides a link field formatter ckeditor_media_embed_link_formatter and hook_ckeditor_media_embed_object_alter(). Medium cases read back the live embed_provider value and which text format enables the filter; hard cases switch the provider to Noembed and enable the filter on a text format, both verified against live config.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal 11 site using the ckeditor_media_embed module, an author inserted a YouTube URL and CKEditor saved an <oembed url="..."> tag into the body. What must be enabled on that text format so the stored <oembed> tag actually renders as embedded media, and what is that filter's machine id?
must_contain_any: Convert Oembed tags to media embeds
evals.expected_output: The 'Convert Oembed tags to media embeds' text filter (id filter_ckeditor_media_embed), a reversible transform filter, must be enabled on that text format. It calls the ckeditor_media_embed service to fetch each <oembed> URL from the configured provider and replace the tag with embed HTML at render time.

evals.prompt: How do I change which oEmbed service the ckeditor_media_embed module uses to resolve media URLs (e.g. from Iframely to Noembed), and where is that setting stored?
evals.expected_output: Set the Provider URL on the settings form at /admin/config/media/ckeditor-media-embed/settings (route ckeditor_media_embed.ckeditor_media_embed_settings_form, permission 'administer filters'), or set the embed_provider key on the ckeditor_media_embed.settings config object (e.g. drush cset). The template uses {url} and {callback} tokens; only one provider is active at a time.

evals.prompt: After enabling ckeditor_media_embed on Drupal 11 the Media embed button doesn't work and the Status Report says plugins are missing. Why, and what command fixes it?
evals.expected_output: The CKEditor 5 media-embed plugin JavaScript is not bundled with the module; it must be downloaded into libraries/ckeditor5/plugins/. Run 'drush ckeditor_media_embed:install' (and 'drush ckeditor_media_embed:update' after a core CKEditor version change). Until then hook_requirements/hook_ckeditor_plugin_info_alter flag the plugin as missing.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the ckeditor_media_embed module is configured with a non-default oEmbed provider. Inspect the live configuration and report the exact Provider URL that ckeditor_media_embed will use to resolve media embeds.
evals.expected_output: The embed_provider in ckeditor_media_embed.settings is //noembed.com/embed?url={url}&callback={callback}&ckme_probe=CKMEPROBE1 (readable with `drush cget ckeditor_media_embed.settings embed_provider`).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a text format that will convert CKEditor <oembed> tags into embedded media. Inspect the live filter-format configuration and state which text format (machine name) has the ckeditor_media_embed conversion filter enabled, and the filter's id.
evals.expected_output: The text format ckme_probe_format has filter_ckeditor_media_embed ('Convert Oembed tags to media embeds') enabled (status: true) in filter.format.ckme_probe_format.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure the ckeditor_media_embed module to resolve media embeds through the Noembed service instead of Iframely. Set its oEmbed Provider URL to exactly //noembed.com/embed?url={url}&callback={callback} and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Set embed_provider on the ckeditor_media_embed.settings config to //noembed.com/embed?url={url}&callback={callback} (via the settings form at /admin/config/media/ckeditor-media-embed/settings or `drush cset ckeditor_media_embed.settings embed_provider '//noembed.com/embed?url={url}&callback={callback}'`).

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a text format with machine name ckme_hard_format that does not yet convert CKEditor media embeds. Using the ckeditor_media_embed module, make that text format convert <oembed> tags into embedded media, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the filter_ckeditor_media_embed ('Convert Oembed tags to media embeds') filter on the ckme_hard_format text format (via /admin/config/content/formats/manage/ckme_hard_format or by setting filters.filter_ckeditor_media_embed.status: true), so filter.format.ckme_hard_format carries that filter enabled.
